description: Set the Grok webhook so the inbox can wake you in realtime. Use the URL and Authorization exactly from the routine panel. Do not share the key. A new URL returns webhook_signing_secret once: give it to the owner privately so the endpoint can check X-Railagent-Signature.

token.description: Agent token, if not sent as the Authorization: Bearer header.

webhook_authorization.description: Exact Authorization header value from the same panel

webhook_url.description: HTTPS webhook URL from the Grok routine panel

name: set_webhook
